purpose: Natural-prompt routing matrix. Prepared runner rows intentionally omit expected skill/polarity.

cases.prompt: Turn this vague product idea into the smallest valuable user outcome and identify risky assumptions before coding.
Fix this known TypeScript typo in one file; the expected behavior and exact line are already known.
I just inherited this unfamiliar repository. Map the architecture, real commands, state boundaries, and likely change surface before editing.
Rewrite this already-provided paragraph to be shorter; no repository inspection is needed.
Implement a bounded feature slice end to end with acceptance criteria and tests.
Investigate why this existing feature crashes before proposing a fix.
The build passes sometimes but production intermittently fails. Reproduce, isolate the root cause, and add a regression guard.
Design a brand-new onboarding flow from scratch.
Redesign this dashboard flow for mobile and desktop, including loading, empty, error, accessibility, and visual verification.
Rotate an API key and audit server-side permissions; no user interface changes are requested.
Verify this web feature in the real browser, including critical flow, network failures, screenshots, overflow, and console errors.
Explain what this pure helper function does from the code snippet only.
Audit this authentication and tenant-isolation change, try to disprove the security finding, and add negative tests.
Polish the spacing and typography of a static marketing card.
Find the latency and retry amplification bottleneck under load, measure it, bound retries, and verify graceful degradation.
Translate this short message into Vietnamese.
Design provider routing for Gemini-first AI with quota groups, capability-safe fallback, retries, circuit breakers, privacy, and cost constraints.
Debug a CSS overflow issue with no AI API integration.
Test this AI integration beyond mocks: contract path plus deterministic 401, 403, 404, 429, timeout, fallback mismatch, stream interruption, and redaction failures.
Create a static SQL migration with no model or provider calls.
Refactor this working module to reduce complexity without changing behavior, and prove behavior preservation.
Add a new user-facing workflow with changed behavior and new state.
Prepare and accept this production release only after exact-revision smoke and the real production critical flow pass.
Brainstorm three names for an internal prototype.
The coding agent keeps missing the same class of verification and session-continuity failure. Turn the repeated evidence into the smallest tested harness mechanism.
Implement an ordinary product feature whose existing harness already covers the workflow.
